description: Three-way merge of two edited copies of one schedule against the copy both started from (Scheduler SPEC 7.1). Each case has explicit base, mine and theirs documents; `choices` maps a conflict key ("task:<id>:<field>", "task:<id>:dep:<id>", "task:<id>:delete", "set:<field>", "hol:<date>") to "mine" for a conflict the person settled; `expect` lists what must hold of the merged result. Language-neutral: only JSON in, JSON-checkable results out. Task ids are stable strings; "taskOrder" is the ids in row order, joined.

cases.name: nobody changed anything
cases.rule: identical copies merge to the same schedule

cases.name: different fields of the same task merge
cases.rule: edits to different fields of one task both survive

cases.name: the same field changed to different values is a conflict; theirs is the default
cases.rule: a conflict defaults to the other person's saved value

cases.name: choosing mine keeps my value
cases.rule: the person can choose their own value for each conflict

cases.name: both change a field to the same value: no conflict
cases.rule: identical edits never conflict

cases.name: each side adds a different task
cases.rule: additions from both sides are kept

cases.name: deleted by them, edited by me: a conflict that defaults to deleted
cases.rule: a delete against an edit is a conflict; the default follows the other person

cases.name: deleted by me, untouched by them
cases.rule: a one-sided delete goes through

cases.name: a deleted task's links are cleaned up
cases.rule: links to a deleted task are removed from the others

cases.name: derived start dates never conflict (only the anchored one does)
cases.rule: a start date that the cascade computed is not an edit; only the activity someone moved by hand can conflict

cases.name: I move Alpha, they rename Charlie: both survive
cases.rule: a move and an unrelated rename merge without conflict

cases.name: each side adds a different link to Delta
cases.rule: links are merged one by one

cases.name: both change the same link differently: a conflict
cases.rule: the same link edited two ways is a conflict

cases.name: a link removed by one side only
cases.rule: a one-sided link removal goes through

cases.name: two edits that together make a loop are merged, and the engine flags the loop
cases.rule: the merge never refuses a result; the cycle check reports it

cases.name: only they reordered: theirs
cases.rule: one side's reorder is taken

cases.name: only I reordered, and they added a row: it stays next to its old neighbour
cases.rule: an added row is placed beside the neighbour it had

cases.name: settings merge field by field
cases.rule: settings changed on different fields (scale, info, colors, holidays) all survive

cases.name: both rename the schedule
cases.rule: the schedule name changed two ways is a conflict; theirs is the default

cases.name: locks set on different tasks both survive
cases.rule: independent lock toggles merge

cases.name: turning a task into a milestone keeps duration 0
cases.rule: kind and duration move together
